{{main article|1990 WTA Tour}}

The [[WTA Tier I events]] are part of the elite tour for professional women's [[tennis]] organised by the [[Women's Tennis Association|WTA]] called the [[WTA Tour]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=1990 Tournaments {{!}} WTA Official |url=https://www.wtatennis.com/tournaments/1990 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://archive.today/20220920181355/https://www.wtatennis.com/tournaments/1990 |archive-date=2022-09-20 |access-date= |website=Women's Tennis Association |language=en}}</ref><ref name="wot1991">{{cite book |title=The International Tennis Federation : World of Tennis 1991 |publisher=Collins Willow |year=1991 |isbn=9780002184038 |editor=[[John Barrett (tennis)|John Barrett]] |location=London |page=155}}</ref>
{{Toc limit|3}}
